headlines.text: On a Friday in 2023, back when DOUKI announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance against Jack Perry, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.43 ? a well-worked match. Battling Jack Perry in a preview of Sunday's IWGP title match, DOUKI put Perry through a table with a top-rope senton before ultimately falling to Perry's borrowed Skull End submission.

Flash back to 2023, when YOH competed under the AEW banner for the first time against Cobb, Fletcher & Ospreay vs. CHAOS vs. Best Friends vs. Kyle Fletcher vs. Will Ospreay vs. Jeff Cobb vs. Swerve Strickland vs. Chuck Taylor vs. Trent Beretta vs. Rocky Romero, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.89.
Rewind to 2023, when Skye Blue vs. Anna Jay AS locked horns for the first time on Rampage, rated 5.22.
